description: Takes order or booking lines (text, supplier, amount) and assigns each to KULIC Advisory's own category tree of 30 categories in nine groups (materials and goods, technical and maintenance, logistics, IT and telecoms, building and energy, office, fleet and travel, services, finance and insurance) by keywords. Returns spend per group and category, rows left open for manual assignment and uncertain rows. A basis for the spend cube and the category profile in businesses without categories. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Rows: text (order or booking text), supplier, amount. German column names work too.

name: sort_categories
title: Category sorter: order or booking texts into a simple category tree, spend per group and category, open rows
